scientific_integrity: New conditional strong-law argument plus classical binary parity and martingale functional limit; all qualifications and source overlap are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Independence across all distinct time-cardinality coefficients is assumed; time-constant coefficients are not covered.
Uniform ellipticity is assumed, and no quantitative convergence rate is claimed.
The proof uses established Kolmogorov and martingale limit theorems; exact finite checks are diagnostic, not infinite certification.
Residual originality risk includes unindexed equivalent claims; no external independent audit.
title: Quenched invariance principle for independent-cardinality bootstrap random walks
